_comment: The Canvas assignment payload for a real IU course assignment, in the shape the Canvas API returns it. Nine all-or-nothing criteria named 'Step 1'..'Step 9' -- the visible name says nothing, and the requirement lives entirely in long_description, which is what Canvas hides behind 'view longer description'. This fixture exists so the binary-rubric path is exercised by the evaluation harness and not only by unit tests.
name: Module One Assignment 1 - Forecast and EDA

rubric.long_description: Open the file and read the whole dataset.
Check for any missing variables. If detected, with 2 methods show how you handle missing values.
Verify the dataset for any duplicated rows. If duplicates are identified, eliminate them.
Perform feature normalization between 0 and 1 if it is needed. Normalization helps to converge machine learning algorithms faster.
Examine the dataset for categorical variables. If any are found, convert them to numerical variables.
Find correlations between the variables and visualize the correlation matrix using a heatmap (1 plot) and scatterplots (minimum 2 plots).
Designate all features, excluding the two last columns ("Next_Tmax" and "Next_Tmin"), as X_variables.
Add a column named "Next_Taverage". The values in this column are the average of columns "Next_Tmin" and "Next_Tmax". Assign the "Next_Taverage" column as the Y_variable.
Remove correlated variables. Explain which variables should be removed and why.
